drafts.text: Amycretin's dual agonism targets both GLP-1 and amylin receptors. In a Phase 2 trial (n=596), participants achieved 13.1% mean weight loss at 20 weeks, compared to 1.1% for placebo. Longer follow-up is needed to assess sustained efficacy and safety.

drafts.text: Benzyl alcohol, typically at 0.9% v/v in bacteriostatic water, acts by denaturing proteins and disrupting bacterial cell membranes. This mechanism provides broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, validated in USP <51> antimicrobial effectiveness testing.

drafts.target_text: @PeptideFrontier Fair point on BW. I'd add that even with the preservative, how you handle it matters, I keep reconstituted vials in the fridge away from light and try not to leave them sitting out on the bench.
drafts.text: Benzyl alcohol's bacteriostatic effect is concentration-dependent, typically 0.9% in BW. Higher concentrations can be irritating, while lower ones may not fully inhibit growth, especially with repeated needle entries.
